principle: One causal family per intervention, one variable changed, one fresh run each. Never combine two prompt changes in a single measurement.

SYSTEM.note: Changes the request packet, so it invalidates the frozen recordings and cannot be scored offline.

MODEL.title: PARTIAL-SPAN DISCOVERY CONTRACT
MODEL.question: If the prompt states that a heading may be an exact substring or prefix inside a sourceAlias, does the model return the correct partial span?
MODEL.whySeparateFromI9: I8 tests boundary selection inside one occurrence. I9 tests which occurrence of a section to claim. Combining them would make any gain unattributable.

MODEL.title: TOC/BODY DOUBLE-CLAIM CONTROL
MODEL.question: Can the model keep the body occurrence without also claiming the navigation occurrence for the same semantic section?
